findings.title: The revised stale-response probe still lacks a browser-handler completion barrier
findings.rationale: Changed channel-transport.spec.ts lines 94–101 await network response completion and two animation frames, but neither observes settlement of api.ts's browser-side res.text() promise or completion of Inbox.responder. Rendering callbacks have no guaranteed ordering after that asynchronous body-consumption continuation. Consequently, the draft and absent-alert assertions can still observe their already-correct pre-completion state before an unfenced continuation clears the draft. The executor-reported mutant failure demonstrates sensitivity in that run, but does not establish the deterministic handler-completion synchronization required by the recorded R02 disposition. This is a protection-harness gap, not a reproduced product vulnerability.
findings.suggested_action: Use test-only browser instrumentation to observe consumption of the exact held POST response and completion of its application continuation before checking the draft and alert. Keep the real BFF response and production DTOs intact. Repeat the guard-removal probe against that synchronized scenario, restore the exact production source, and obtain candidate-bound browser/all results.
